It is now scoped to accounts whose final bill has dropped. The record test is "final_bill_date and service_end_date both recorded" and is stated in the rule's first sentence: as with every uninsured discount, none is owed while the stay is open or the account is still pending_billing.
  - Compute mirrors the test with the plain binding `ob_billed = 1 if (F('final_bill_date') and F('service_end_date')) else 0`, and the result is 0 outside scope.
  - Both overwrite restatements (the once-per-SELF_PAY_FINAL_BILL posting sentence and the SELF_PAY gate) name the same scope.
  - The courtesy's wait on this discount now reads "...where observation hours were billed on a final-billed account not priced under a self-pay package". Its condition adds "whose final_bill_date and service_end_date are recorded". An out-of-scope stay therefore never blocks the courtesy, and no 0.00 write is routed.
  - The round-4 clause "including a stay with no service_end_date yet (0 plain days)" now describes an out-of-scope case and was removed from the day-count sentence and ladder. The compute guard on the same-day tier stays and agrees with the rule.
  - Where: encounter_ext_observation_rate_discount and encounter_ext_service_recovery_courtesy (prerequisite E3b); tasks/1.json prerequisite_closure edge to the observation rule (condition, policy_source, evidence of the final_bill_date) and design_rationale §3, §5, §8, §13b.

- Class sweep: every other extended discount or adjustment write already sits after the final bill by its own scope record.
  - encounter_ext_noncovered_discount needs a NONCOVERED_SERVICE liability posting, which exists only after the payer adjudicates a final-billed claim.
